chapterInfo.content:
30
Hiob kyerɛ ne seesei asetena a ɛyɛ mmɔborɔ
1 # Hiob 29.8-11 Na afei wɔn a mekyɛne wɔn panin koraa sere me,
wɔn a mepo wɔn agyanom
sɛ mede wɔn bɛhyɛ me nkraman a wɔhwɛ me nnwankuo so mu,
2wɔn nsam tumi nso bɛyɛ me dɛn,
wɔn a wɔn ahoɔden asa?
3Ohia ne ɛkɔm nti wɔatwintwam,
wɔwewe nkyɛkyerɛ so
deɛ ɛhɔ yɛ sakasaka, kusuu ne basabasa.
4Wɔtete nkyenhahan wɔ nnuaa so,
na ɛserɛ so nnuaa nhini ne wɔn aduane.
5Wɔatu wɔn afiri nnipa mu,
wɔhuro wɔn sɛ owifoɔ.
6Mmonhwa a ɛhɔ yɛ hu mu na wɔteteɛ,
ɛfam ne abotan mu ntokuro mu.
7Nnua ntam na wɔbobom,
nsansono ase na wɔsam.
8Agyegyentwie mma ne wɔn,
wɔn a wɔnni din mma nso,
wɔapam wɔn afiri asase so.
9 # Hiob 17.6; Dwom 69.12; Kwa 3.63 Na afei madane wɔn sankuo dwom,
na mayɛ wɔn sɛmɔdɛ.
10 # Mat 26.27 Wɔkyiri me, wɔma me ne wɔn ntam twe,
na wɔnkame sɛ wɔtoto ntasuo gu m’ani soɔ.
11Na ɛnam sɛ Onyankopɔn asane me homa, na wabrɛ me aseɛ nti,
wɔn nso ato ahohyɛsoɔ atwene wɔ m’anim.
12Me nifa so na ahuhufoɔ no asɔreɛ,
wɔsum me fidie,
na wɔdane wɔn sɛeɛ akwan ba me so.
13Wɔdwiri me kwan,
wɔboa me sɛeɛ,
nso obiara biara nsianka wɔn.
14Wɔba sɛ obuba a emu trɛ,
wɔnam huuyɛ no mu munimuni ba.
15Ahuyideɛ adane hwɛ me so,
wɔpamo me bakomadie sɛ mframa,
na me yiedie asene kɔ sɛ mununkum.
16 # Dwom 42.4 Na afei me kra nane gu me mu,
amanehunu nna asosɔ me mu.
17Anadwo hodwo me nnompe wɔ me mu,
na yea a ɛwe me no nnyae.
18 # Hiob 7.5 Emu den nko ara nti m’atadeɛ asakyera,
ɛmia me sɛ me kamisaa kɔn.
19Wato me atwene atɛkyɛ mu,
me ho ayɛ sɛ dɔteɛ ne nso.
20 # Hiob 19.7; Dwom 22.2 Mesu mefrɛ wo, na wonnye me so,
megyina hɔ, na wohwɛ me haa.
21Woadane ayɛ sɛ otirimuɔdenfoɔ ama me,
wode wo nsa a ɛyɛ den ne me di asie.
22Woma me so ma metena mframa so kɔ,
na woma menane huuyɛ mu.
23Na menim sɛ wode me bɛsane ama owuo
ne efie a ateasefoɔ hyia mu no.
24Nanso obi ntene ne nsa nhwehwɛ ɔgyeɛ nkunkumaboɔkuo mu,
na sɛ obi reyera a, ɔnsu mfrɛ ɔboafoɔ anaa?
25Mansu mamma deɛ ɔwɔ amaneɛ mu,
ohiani anyɛ me kra mmɔbɔ anaa?
26 # Yer 14.19 Na metwɛn adepa, nso bɔne na aba,
na m’ani daa hann so, na esum kabii aba.
27Me yamuadeɛ huru, na ɛnnyae,
amanehunu nna ato me.
28Mabiri tumm na menenam, nso ɛmfiri awia;
mesɔre badwa mu na meteam.
29Madane ɛserɛ so akraman nua
ne sohoribereɛ adamfo.
30Me wedeɛ abiri rewae afiri me ho,
na ahuhuro nti me nnompe ahye.
31 # Dwom 30.11 Na me sankuo adane abooboo,
na me tɛntɛbɛn adane asufoɔ nne.

Na afei wɔn a mekyɛne wɔn panin koraa sere me,
wɔn a mepo wɔn agyanom
sɛ mede wɔn bɛhyɛ me nkraman a wɔhwɛ me nnwankuo so mu,
wɔn nsam tumi nso bɛyɛ me dɛn,
wɔn a wɔn ahoɔden asa?
Ohia ne ɛkɔm nti wɔatwintwam,
wɔwewe nkyɛkyerɛ so
deɛ ɛhɔ yɛ sakasaka, kusuu ne basabasa.
Wɔtete nkyenhahan wɔ nnuaa so,
na ɛserɛ so nnuaa nhini ne wɔn aduane.
Wɔatu wɔn afiri nnipa mu,
wɔhuro wɔn sɛ owifoɔ.
Mmonhwa a ɛhɔ yɛ hu mu na wɔteteɛ,
ɛfam ne abotan mu ntokuro mu.
Nnua ntam na wɔbobom,
nsansono ase na wɔsam.
Agyegyentwie mma ne wɔn,
wɔn a wɔnni din mma nso,
wɔapam wɔn afiri asase so.

Na afei madane wɔn sankuo dwom,
na mayɛ wɔn sɛmɔdɛ.
Wɔkyiri me, wɔma me ne wɔn ntam twe,
na wɔnkame sɛ wɔtoto ntasuo gu m’ani soɔ.
Na ɛnam sɛ Onyankopɔn asane me homa, na wabrɛ me aseɛ nti,
wɔn nso ato ahohyɛsoɔ atwene wɔ m’anim.
Me nifa so na ahuhufoɔ no asɔreɛ,
wɔsum me fidie,
na wɔdane wɔn sɛeɛ akwan ba me so.
Wɔdwiri me kwan,
wɔboa me sɛeɛ,
nso obiara biara nsianka wɔn.
Wɔba sɛ obuba a emu trɛ,
wɔnam huuyɛ no mu munimuni ba.
Ahuyideɛ adane hwɛ me so,
wɔpamo me bakomadie sɛ mframa,
na me yiedie asene kɔ sɛ mununkum.

Na afei me kra nane gu me mu,
amanehunu nna asosɔ me mu.
Anadwo hodwo me nnompe wɔ me mu,
na yea a ɛwe me no nnyae.
Emu den nko ara nti m’atadeɛ asakyera,
ɛmia me sɛ me kamisaa kɔn.
Wato me atwene atɛkyɛ mu,
me ho ayɛ sɛ dɔteɛ ne nso.
Mesu mefrɛ wo, na wonnye me so,
megyina hɔ, na wohwɛ me haa.
Woadane ayɛ sɛ otirimuɔdenfoɔ ama me,
wode wo nsa a ɛyɛ den ne me di asie.
Woma me so ma metena mframa so kɔ,
na woma menane huuyɛ mu.
Na menim sɛ wode me bɛsane ama owuo
ne efie a ateasefoɔ hyia mu no.

Nanso obi ntene ne nsa nhwehwɛ ɔgyeɛ nkunkumaboɔkuo mu,
na sɛ obi reyera a, ɔnsu mfrɛ ɔboafoɔ anaa?
Mansu mamma deɛ ɔwɔ amaneɛ mu,
ohiani anyɛ me kra mmɔbɔ anaa?
Na metwɛn adepa, nso bɔne na aba,
na m’ani daa hann so, na esum kabii aba.
Me yamuadeɛ huru, na ɛnnyae,
amanehunu nna ato me.
Mabiri tumm na menenam, nso ɛmfiri awia;
mesɔre badwa mu na meteam.
Madane ɛserɛ so akraman nua
ne sohoribereɛ adamfo.
Me wedeɛ abiri rewae afiri me ho,
na ahuhuro nti me nnompe ahye.
Na me sankuo adane abooboo,
na me tɛntɛbɛn adane asufoɔ nne.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
